name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: A middleware-free Agent platform starter kit running Codex CLI locally or on Volcengine ECS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,logs -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/log-viewer"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server && npm run build -w @launchpad/log-viewer
scripts.test: npm run test -w @launchpad/server && npm run test -w @launchpad/log-viewer
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
